claim_text: The people who assassinated or attempted to assassinate presidents Abraham Lincoln, John F. Kennedy, Ronald Reagan and Donald Trump; Attorney General Robert F. Kennedy; civil rights activist Martin Luther King Jr.; and conservative pundit Charlie Kirk all were registered Democrats.
query: The people who assassinated or attempted to assassinate presidents Abraham Lincoln John
summary: - Suspected Perpetrator: Ryan Wesley Routh - Weapon: Semiautomatic assault rifle On September 15, 2024, the FBI announced that it was investigating an apparent attempted assassination of Trump earlier that day while he was golfing with a friend at the Trump International Golf Club in West Palm Beach, Florida, near Trump’s Mar-a-Lago estate. - Suspected Perpetrator: Cole Tomas Allen - Weapon: Knives, handgun, shotgun On April 25, 2026, the White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner, an annual event intended to celebrate freedom of the press, was rocked when a man armed with multiple weapons fired shots and tried to breach the security perimeter of the ballroom of the Washington Hilton hotel, where the event was being held. Authors Rachel Dinning is digital editor (engagement and video) at HistoryExtra From Kennedy to Reagan and now, for a third time, Trump: A history of political violence in the United States The latest attack on the Republican comes in a country that has seen four presidents assassinated while in office Gunfire shattered the White House Correspondents’ Dinner at 8:36 p.m.
